content.en: The **Global Foreign Exchange Committee (GFXC)** serves as the primary international body responsible for the **FX Global Code**, a set of global principles of good practice in the foreign exchange market. It acts as a bridge between central banks and market participants to ensure transparency and ethical conduct.
